title: Pancakes
notes: Best served with maple syrup or fresh berries.

steps.description: Mix dry ingredients: flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Make a well in the center and pour in milk, eggs, and melted butter.
Whisk until just combined — lumps are fine. Don't overmix.
tips: A few lumps ensure tender pancakes

steps.description: Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat. Add a small knob of butter.
Pour a ladle of batter (about ¼ cup per pancake). Cook until bubbles form on surface.
tips: Bubbles that don't pop mean it's time to flip

steps.description: Flip and cook until golden brown, about 1-2 minutes more.
Mix flour, sugar, and a pinch of salt in a microwave-safe mug.
Add milk, egg, and melted butter. Stir until smooth.
tips: Make sure there are no dry flour pockets at the bottom

steps.description: Microwave on high for 90 seconds. Check if center is set.
tips: If still wet in center, add 15-30 seconds more

steps.description: Let cool for 1 minute before eating from the mug.
